svg.text: Feierabend — Privacy Data-Flow & Record of Processing
Personal-data map for privacy & legal review — aligned to GDPR Art. 30 (record of processing) and CCPA/CPRA disclosures.
Good-faith engineering artifact, not legal advice. Current deployment is a US-only demonstration with no real customers. Companion to PRIVACY_REVIEW.md and privacy.html.
Deno · streaming chat + tool loop · cache
Both use the service-role key (bypass RLS); secrets server-only.
reads via service-role · sees IP/PII · transcript export is PII-gated
register + checkout / address form → commission fn → orders
browser → concierge fn (answer & improve); text relayed to Claude API
recorded on the conversation + rate-limit store (abuse / lawful request)
attributes chat to the account when signed in

One email → concierge@feier-abend.co (monitored) — access · rectify · erase · portability · restrict · object · withdraw consent · CCPA know/delete/correct · 45-day response · GPC honored · non-discrimination.
N/A — US data subjects, US processors (Supabase, Anthropic); no cross-border transfer to safeguard; pages load no third-party resources.
Payment data · sensitive personal information · advertising trackers/cookies · phone number · date of birth.
Light profiling for personalization (from orders + client book). No GDPR Art. 22 solely-automated, significant-effect decisions.
Aggregate only — the coach feedback loop reads reply-rate-by-move into concierge_insights + the coach prompt; no identifiers, no new personal data produced or sent to a sub-processor.
Controller: Feierabend Textil (fictional house, demo). Security: row-level security · encryption in transit · secrets server-only.
Record of Processing (GDPR Art. 30) — by data category
Sources: privacy.html · supabase/SCHEMA.md · PRIVACY_REVIEW.md. Reflects the current US-only demo; production would add a signed DPA per processor and (if EU) SCCs + an Art. 27 representative.
